message.Title: Public Preview: Microsoft Defender for Cloud + GitHub Advanced Security
Services: GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps

Body.Content: With Microsoft Defender for Cloud and GitHub Advanced Security, protect cloud-native applications across the full app lifecycle from code to cloud. This natively integrated solution helps unify developers and security teams in one workflow while staying in the tools they use every day. Identify vulnerabilities early and connect live threat insights from production environments directly to the vulnerabilities that matter to help prioritize risks. And with Copilot Autofix and the Coding agent, developer teams can apply AI-suggested fixes in minutes, reducing remediation time.
